summary.text: Scott Burns is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House representing Merrimack 2 from 2012 to 2014, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a former state representative and school board member.

paragraphs.text: Scott Burns earned a high school diploma from Franklin High School and a graduate degree from New England College in 2014.
His career experience includes working in fundraising.
Burns won election to the House in the November 6, 2012 general election and during the 2013 legislative session served on the Environment and Agriculture Committee.
He ran again in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024 and was not elected in those general elections.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Merrimack 3 on September 8, 2026, with 56.1 percent of the vote.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Burns listed his key campaign messages as stopping the downshifting of costs to lower property taxes, funding education, and making special education affordable.
He listed the 314 Action Fund, Rights for Democracy and AFT-NH as endorsers.
